question:
According to Appendix 3, Table 3-A, compare *Salmonella* species and *Listeria
monocytogenes* by minimum water activity, pH range, temperature range, maximum
water-phase salt, and oxygen requirement.

claims.text: Salmonella species have a minimum water activity of 0.94 (using salt), minimum pH of 3.7, maximum pH of 9.5, maximum water-phase salt of 8%, minimum temperature of 41.4°F (5.2°C), maximum temperature of 115.2°F (46.2°C), and are facultative anaerobes.

Listeria monocytogenes has a minimum water activity of 0.92 (using salt), minimum pH of 4.4, maximum pH of 9.4, maximum water-phase salt of 10%, minimum temperature of 31.3°F (-0.4°C), maximum temperature of 113°F (45°C), and is a facultative anaerobe.
